title: Tenant screening fee disclosure requirement

title: Prohibition of Anti-Competitive Automated Rent Price-Fixing
requirement: Santa Ana prohibits selling, licensing, or otherwise providing an algorithmic device to a landlord, and prohibits landlords from using an algorithmic device to set rental rates or occupancy levels for residential rental property in the city. Tenants may sue for injunctive relief, damages, or civil penalties up to $1,000 per violation, with each month and each residential rental property constituting a separate violation for landlord use.
key_value: Up to $1,000 per violation; each month and each residential rental property is a separate violation for landlord use

coverage_conditions_ir.text: Applies to residential rental property in Santa Ana, including dwellings or units intended for human habitation and units in a mobile home park.
coverage_conditions_ir.quote:
"Residential Rental Property" means any dwelling or unit that is intended for
human habitation, including any dwelling or unit in a mobile home park.

exemptions_ir.value: software exception
exemptions_ir.text: Excluded software that publishes reports from aggregated historical nonpublic competitor data more than 90 days old or public information and does not recommend future rental rates or occupancy levels.
exemptions_ir.quote:
Algorithmic Device does not include either of the following:
1) A software or product used by a Person to publish reports regarding
rental rates or occupancy levels from aggregated historical Nonpublic
Competitor Data that is more than 90 days old, or from information available to
the general public, and does not recommend rental rates or occupancy levels
for future Residential Rental Property Leases or renewals.

exemptions_ir.text: Excluded software used to establish rental rates or income limits under affordable housing program guidelines.
exemptions_ir.quote:
2) A software or product used by a Person to establish rental rates or
income limits in accordance with local, state, or federal affordable housing
program guidelines.
